agents.name: Project Manager
agents.description: Plans projects, analyses meetings, and turns decisions into safe next actions.

Build a practical project plan from this document
Show me the highest-priority work in my local project

settingsFields.label: Who is usually in your meetings

settingsFields.label: How you word and time your to-dos
settingsFields.description: Preferred task style, timing, and ownership conventions.

agents.name: Business Development
agents.description: Tracks lost leads, gathers honest feedback, and keeps deadline-driven opportunities — festival press passes, pitch sessions, prizes and open calls — from slipping.
examplePrompts: We lost a job to another quote — log the lost lead and draft a short feedback ask

A lost lead just replied with feedback — record what they said
What opportunity deadlines are coming up?
Draft a press accreditation pitch for Annecy using the media kit

agents.description: Researches prospects, drafts replies, and turns calls into proposals.

settingsFields.label: Who you sell to
settingsFields.description: Sector, job titles, and company size.

settingsFields.label: How your outreach should sound
settingsFields.description: Tone, structure, and words to avoid.

agents.description: Reviews grants, funding evidence, and business updates without making financial decisions.

agents.name: Strategy

agents.name: Sourcing
agents.description: Builds Oddtoe's vetted China supply chain — art-toy, inflatable and soft-goods factories in the Pearl River Delta, tracked from candidate to vetted through the ham-bag gate.
